from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
import copy, hashlib, json, re, calendar
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pdfplumber
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/"reports/research/510300_actual_loan_allocation_prior_use_source_v1"
def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(p):
    return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def rel(p):
    return str(p.relative_to(root)).replace("\\","/")
def save(name,value):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("原稿解析产物已存在，不重复："+rel(p))
    p.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":digest(p)}
def norm(s):
    return re.sub(r"\s+","",s).replace("％","%")
protocol=read(out/"protocol.json")
assert digest(out/"protocol.json")=="d206290a70bc75357035203fd4bdafe653d3516a5ab99a7f9ec8828164479a68"
for p in protocol["parents"]:
    assert digest(root/p["path"])==p["sha256"],p["path"]
save("同原HTML公开头位置修正解析认领_E114.json",{"at":now(),"same_source_parser_revision":"V1.0.1","previous_parse_failed_assertion":"期望3量/2钟，但原解析仅在article外找头，两个真实日期位于article内，误记0钟。","original_parser_and_partial_record_retained":True,"new_requests":0,"new_financial_attempts":0})
parent_path=root/"reports/research/510300_original_collection_inventory_joint_state_decomposition_v1/全部79原身份_完整共同背景与回款库存量时间状态_E112.json"
parent=read(parent_path)["rows"]
assert len(parent)==79
old_by={r["original_sequence_idx"]:r for r in parent}
patterns=[
("人民币全部贷款",r"金融机构人民币各项贷款余额","人民币","全国各项贷款"),
("企业主体全部贷款",r"(?:本外币)?(?:非金融企业及机关团体|企事业单位)贷款余额","本外币","原非金融企业及机关团体或企事业单位"),
("企业短期及票据",r"短期贷款及票据融资余额","本外币","同原企业主体"),
("企业中长期",r"(?<!工业)(?<!服务业)中长期贷款余额","本外币","同原企业主体"),
("企业固定资产用途",r"(?:非金融企业及机关团体)?固定资产贷款余额","本外币","同原企业主体"),
("企业经营用途",r"(?<!住户)经营性贷款余额","本外币","同原企业主体"),
("工业中长期",r"工业中长期贷款余额","本外币","原工业借款总体，不等于NBS规上或当月CSI300"),
("重工业中长期",r"重工业中长期贷款余额","本外币","原重工业"),
("轻工业中长期",r"轻工业中长期贷款余额","本外币","原轻工业"),
("服务业中长期",r"服务业中长期贷款余额","本外币","原服务业"),
("基础设施中长期",r"基础设施(?:相关行业)?中长期贷款余额","本外币","原基础设施定义，可能与服务业/绿色分类交叉"),
("房地产全部",r"人民币房地产贷款余额","人民币","原房地产相关贷款"),
("房地产开发",r"房地产开发贷款余额","人民币","同原房地产开发总体"),
("个人住房",r"个人住房贷款余额","人民币","同原个人住房贷款"),
("住户全部",r"(?:本外币)?住户贷款余额","本外币","原住户借款总体"),
("住户经营",r"住户经营性贷款余额","本外币","原住户经营用途"),
("住户消费原范围",r"(?:住户(?:其他)?消费性贷款(?:（不含个人住房贷款）)?|不含个人住房贷款的消费性贷款)余额","本外币","保留是否包含住房的原范围，不跨三个原期拼同比"),
("普惠小微原范围",r"(?:普惠口径小微贷款|普惠小微贷款)[1-5]?余额","人民币","原授信门槛及借款主体定义"),
("绿色贷款原范围",r"绿色贷款[1-5]?余额","本外币","原绿色认定标准"),
("涉农原范围",r"涉农贷款[1-5]?余额","本外币","原涉农/农村范围")
]
rows=[]
for spec in protocol["fixed_cases"]:
    q=spec["fixed_target_loan_stat_quarter"]
    receipt_path=out/f"{q}_唯一新首次GET回执_E114.json"
    rec=read(receipt_path)
    row={"fixed_original_case":spec,"source_url":rec["selection"]["url"],"source_receipt":{"path":rel(receipt_path),"sha256":digest(receipt_path)},
         "quantity_qualified":False,"own_publication_at":"UNKNOWN","own_clock_qualified":False,
         "joint_quantity_clock_pass":False,"unknowns":[],"historical_first_vintage_authenticated":False}
    if rec.get("http_status")!=200:
        row["unknowns"].append(rec["status"]); rows.append(row); continue
    p=root/rec["path"]; assert digest(p)==rec["sha256"]
    row.update({"raw_source_path":rel(p),"raw_source_sha256":digest(p),"source_type":p.suffix})
    if p.suffix==".pdf":
        with pdfplumber.open(p) as doc:
            pages=[{"page_number":i+1,"original_full_page_text":page.extract_text() or "",
                    "line_detected_tables_not_assumed_native":page.extract_tables()} for i,page in enumerate(doc.pages)]
            row["original_pdf_metadata"]=dict(doc.metadata)
            row["complete_original_pdf_pages"]=pages
            row["original_pdf_page_count"]=len(pages)
            text="\n".join(r["original_full_page_text"] for r in pages)
            clean_pages=[]
            for page in pages:
                lines=page["original_full_page_text"].splitlines()
                if lines and lines[-1].strip()==str(page["page_number"]):
                    lines=lines[:-1]
                clean_pages.append("\n".join(lines))
            paragraph_text="\n".join(clean_pages)
        row["own_clock_status"]="PDF_HAS_CREATION_DATE_NOT_PUBLICATION_EVIDENCE"
        row["unknowns"].append("PDF正文无原公开钟；CreationDate/ModDate/URL数字不当发布日期")
        source_title=pages[0]["original_full_page_text"].splitlines()[0]
        row["all_original_method_notes"]=[s for s in paragraph_text.splitlines() if any(k in s for k in ["授信","包括","口径","县及县以下"])]
        row["complete_native_html_tables"]=[]
    else:
        soup=BeautifulSoup(p.read_bytes(),"html.parser")
        body=soup.select_one("article#articleins")
        if body is None:
            row["unknowns"].append("无全国全文原正文节点")
            rows.append(row);continue
        text=body.get_text(" ",strip=True)
        paragraph_text=text
        visible=soup.get_text(" ",strip=True)
        before_body=visible.split(text,1)[0]
        first_native_stat=re.search(r"(?:中国)?人民银行统计",text)
        native_article_header=text[:first_native_stat.start()] if first_native_stat else ""
        before_body=before_body+" "+native_article_header
        row["original_html_article"]=str(body)
        row["complete_native_html_tables"]=[{"rows":[[{"text":c.get_text(" ",strip=True),"rowspan":c.get("rowspan","1"),"colspan":c.get("colspan","1")} for c in tr.find_all(["td","th"],recursive=False)] for tr in table.find_all("tr")]} for table in body.find_all("table")]
        row["all_original_method_notes"]=[e.get_text(" ",strip=True) for e in body.find_all(["p","div"],recursive=False) if e.get_text(" ",strip=True).startswith("注")]
        if not row["all_original_method_notes"]:
            row["all_original_method_notes"]=re.findall(r"注[1-5][：:].*?(?=注[1-5][：:]|$)",text)
        row["original_meta_fields"]=[dict(m.attrs) for m in soup.find_all("meta")]
        row["original_header_visible_text"]=before_body
        source_title=soup.title.get_text(strip=True) if soup.title else rec["selection"]["title"]
        date=re.search(r"(?<!\d)(\d{4})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})(?!\d)",before_body)
        if date:
            dt=datetime(int(date[1]),int(date[2]),int(date[3]),23,59,59,tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=8)))
            row["own_publication_at"]=dt.isoformat()
            row["own_clock_kind"]="OWN_GOVERNMENT_FULL_REPRINT_DATE_END_CONSERVATIVE_UPPER_BOUND_NOT_EARLIEST_PBOC"
            row["own_clock_qualified"]=dt<=datetime.fromisoformat(spec["same_original_cutoff"])
            row["own_clock_status"]="BEFORE_FIXED_ORIGINAL_CUTOFF" if row["own_clock_qualified"] else "AFTER_FIXED_ORIGINAL_CUTOFF"
        else:
            row["unknowns"].append("原正文头无明确自己公布日期")
    row["native_title"]=source_title
    row["complete_original_article_text"]=text
    canonical=norm(paragraph_text)
    year=int(q[:4]); quarter=int(q[-1]); label={1:"一",2:"二",3:"三",4:"四"}[quarter]
    row["original_year_quarter_identity_pass"]=str(year) in norm(source_title) and (label+"季度" in norm(source_title))
    row["source_currency_and_population_qualifiers"]=[s for s in re.split(r"[。；]",paragraph_text) if any(w in s for w in ["本外币","人民币","口径","包括","不含","名单","不可比","会计科目","获贷率"])]
    atoms=[]
    for kind,pat,currency,population in patterns:
        matches=list(re.finditer(pat+r"([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(万亿元|亿元)",canonical))
        if not matches:
            atoms.append({"kind":kind,"status":"UNKNOWN_NOT_REPORTED_OR_NOT_MATCHED","currency_context":currency,"native_population_scope":population,"balance_yi":None,"reported_stock_yoy_pct":None})
            continue
        match=matches[0]
        start,end=match.span()
        remaining=canonical[end:]
        stop=min([pos for pos in (remaining.find("。"),remaining.find("；")) if pos>=0] or [len(remaining)])
        tail=remaining[:stop]
        literal=canonical[max(0,start-30):end+min(stop,150)]
        growth=re.search(r"同比(增长|下降|减少)([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(%|个百分点)",tail)
        rate=None; growth_status="UNKNOWN_NATIVE_YOY_NOT_FOUND"
        if growth:
            if growth[3]=="%":
                rate=float(growth[2])*(-1 if growth[1] in ("下降","减少") else 1)
                growth_status="NATIVE_REPORTED_PERCENT"
            else:
                growth_status="AMBIGUOUS_NATIVE_PERCENTAGE_POINT_PHRASE_NOT_REWRITTEN_TO_PERCENT"
        amount=float(match[1]); unit=match[2]
        atoms.append({"kind":kind,"status":"NATIVE_BALANCE_EXTRACTED","balance_native_number":amount,"balance_native_unit":unit,
                      "balance_yi":amount*(10000 if unit=="万亿元" else 1),"currency_context":currency,
                      "currency_assignment_kind":"原明确标签或同一原章节的借款主体/币种，未跨人民币/本外币求和",
                      "native_population_scope":population,"reported_stock_yoy_pct":rate,"native_yoy_status":growth_status,
                      "original_span":literal,"match_start":start,"native_growth_literal":growth.group() if growth else None,
                      "use_as_financial_feature":False})
    row["loan_allocation_original_atoms"]=atoms
    row["all_original_number_unit_atoms"]=[{"literal":m.group(),"position":m.start()} for m in re.finditer(r"[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:万亿元|亿元|%|个百分点|个基点|万元|万家)",canonical)]
    major={a["kind"]:a for a in atoms}
    row["quantity_qualified"]=row["original_year_quarter_identity_pass"] and all(major[k]["balance_yi"] is not None for k in ["人民币全部贷款","企业主体全部贷款","工业中长期","房地产全部","住户全部"])
    if not row["quantity_qualified"]:
        row["unknowns"].append("原期身份或主要原数量母体未同时合格")
    row["joint_quantity_clock_pass"]=row["quantity_qualified"] and row["own_clock_qualified"]
    row["loan_allocation_current_input_if_joint_pass"]=copy.deepcopy(atoms) if row["joint_quantity_clock_pass"] else None
    row["archival_only_if_own_clock_unknown"]=row["quantity_qualified"] and not row["own_clock_qualified"]
    row["economic_quarter_end"]=f"{year}-{quarter*3:02d}-{calendar.monthrange(year,quarter*3)[1]:02d}"
    cutoff=datetime.fromisoformat(spec["same_original_cutoff"])
    row["loan_statistical_period_age_days_at_current_cutoff"]=(cutoff-datetime.fromisoformat(row["economic_quarter_end"]+"T23:59:59+08:00")).total_seconds()/86400
    row["own_release_age_days_at_current_cutoff"]=None if not row["own_clock_qualified"] else (cutoff-datetime.fromisoformat(row["own_publication_at"])).total_seconds()/86400
    old=old_by[spec["original_sequence_idx"]]
    assert old["economic_period"]==spec["economic_period"] and old["same_original_cutoff"]==spec["same_original_cutoff"]
    row["old_current_operating_values_unchanged"]=copy.deepcopy(old["current_original_values_unchanged"])
    row["old_collection_inventory_joint_cell_unchanged"]=old["current_joint_cell"]
    row["complete_old_same_cutoff_price_funding_order_profit_collection_inventory_and_aged_fund_unchanged"]=copy.deepcopy(old["current_complete_joint_background_same_clock"])
    row["actual_cash_received"]="UNKNOWN"
    row["net_new_disbursement_rollover_repayment_and_writeoff_split"]="UNKNOWN"
    row["market_expectation_surprise"]="UNKNOWN"
    row["index_exact_month_end_fine_exposure"]="UNKNOWN"
    row["financial_score"]="NOT_COMPUTED"
    row["current_fixed79_stock_labels_read"]=False
    rows.append(row)
    main=major["工业中长期"]
    print(json.dumps({"quarter":q,"quantity_pass":row["quantity_qualified"],"own_publication":row["own_publication_at"],
      "clock_pass":row["own_clock_qualified"],"industrial_long_balance_yi":main["balance_yi"],
      "industrial_long_yoy":main["reported_stock_yoy_pct"],
      "old_joint_state":row["old_collection_inventory_joint_cell_unchanged"],
      "native_methods":row["all_original_method_notes"],
      "ambiguous_native_fields":[a["kind"] for a in atoms if a.get("native_yoy_status","").startswith("AMBIGUOUS")]},ensure_ascii=False))
assert [r["fixed_original_case"]["fixed_target_loan_stat_quarter"] for r in rows]==["2018Q3","2022Q1","2025Q3"]
